newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Mercury Finance suspended.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Mercury Finance suspended.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it continues to suspend coverage of Mercury Finance Co.
-- Gruntal first suspended its rating on Mercury Jan 30 and said the rating will remain suspended until Mercury has finances "that we can place faith in, i.e. audited."

-- said company is cooperating fully with Federal Bureau of Investigation, which searched Mercury Finance on Monday. While the investigation was expected, Gruntal analyst Katrina Blecher said "there is no possible way to interpret this as positive."
-- said company has been focusing on its liquidity problems. If a plan for short-term funding is worked out, it will have a positive impact on the stock, Gruntal said.
-- said believes shares "have fallen too far to warrant exiting current positions and we would wait to sell."
-- said viewed as positive Mercury Finance's announcement that Chief Executive John Brincate resigned and was replaced by William Brandt, president of Development Specialists.
